storyMemory.title: The Wrong Painting Worth Millions
storyMemory.summary: An art critic argues with a stranger over a museum masterpiece, only to discover the painting is an accidental portrait of his own lost pet painted yesterday.
storyMemory.setting: Sunny modern art gallery with colorful walls
storyMemory.conflict: An aggressive art critic clashes with a casual gallery visitor over the meaning of a bizarre portrait.
events: A grumpy art critic dismisses a chaotic modern painting in a gallery
A casual stranger casually defends the chaotic brushwork as pure genius
The critic leans in closer to inspect the wild swirling textures
They both realize the abstract masterpiece is actually a giant accident
storyMemory.twist: The museum masterpiece is not fine art at all, but a wet canvas left by a runaway dog yesterday morning.
storyMemory.ending: The director rushes over with a blank check while the stunned owner whistles for his terrier.
storyMemory.fingerprint: art critic gallery painting dog accident masterpiece modern art
